briefdescription.para: This pass exposes codegen information to IR-level passes.

detaileddescription.para:
Every transformation that uses codegen information is broken into three parts:
The IR-level analysis pass.
The IR-level transformation interface which provides the needed information.
Codegen-level implementation which uses target-specific hooks.
This file defines #2, which is the interface that IR-level transformations use for querying the codegen.
